gpSelfConfirm: Irekhodi lendawo lalesi sisetshenziswa lithi wena udale leli qembu. Qinisekisa isazisi sakho sokusayina esiqinisekisiwe sendawo njengomphathi? Ubunikazi bokubethela: {0}. Ukhiye wokusayina: {1}. Amanye amalungu kufanele aqinisekise ngokuzimela futhi aqinisekise.
gpAnchorConfirm: Qinisekisa {0} ({1}) njengomphathi waleli qembu? Yilo khiye wokusayina kuphela ozovunyelwa ukugunyaza ukuvikelwa kombhali okuncishisiwe.
gpDowngradeWarning: La malungu awakhangisi ukwesekwa kombhali osayiniwe: {0}. Ukuzivumela kusho ukuthi noma yiliphi ilungu elinokhiye weqembu elihlanganyelwe lingalingisa omunye umbhali. Amalungu akhona azothola isaziso esiqhubekayo. Ukukhansela kugcina ukuvikelwa okuqinile futhi akuvumi lolu shintsho.
gpUnanchored: Akekho umphathi oqinisekisiwe. Ukuvikelwa okuqinile akukwazi ukwehliswa uze uqinisekise futhi uqinisekise oxhumana naye we-admin.
gpDropped: ⚠ Ukuvikelwa kombhali kuncishisiwe ngumlawuli oqoshiwe. Imilayezo yefa ayikuqinisekisi umbhali ngamunye.
gpRestored: ✓ Ukuvikelwa kombhali osayiniwe kubuyiselwe. Imilayezo engasayiniwe iyanqatshelwa.
gpVerifyFirst: Qinisekisa inombolo yokuphepha yale xhumana kuqala, bese uqinisekise njengomphathi ovela kuleli qembu.
gpFailed: Isibuyekezo sezokuphepha seqembu sehlulekile. Izinguquko ezingavunyelwanga zihlala zivinjelwe.
snV2: Inombolo yokuphepha v2 · Amadijithi angama-60 · isikhombisi-esiboshwe
snLegacy: Inombolo yokuphepha yefa · Amabhithi angama-96. Qhathanisa inguqulo efanayo kuphela; Lesi sibonisi asiguquli ukuqinisekisa.
snVersion: Izinguqulo ezihlukile zokubonisa. Bobabili bakhetha inombolo yefa bese beqhathanisa futhi. Lokhu akusona isibonakaliso soshintsho olubalulekile.
snMismatch: Ukuqhathaniswa kwe-QR akuzange kuhambelane. Hlola othintwayo kanye nokhiye bobabili ngaphambi kokuqinisekisa.
mrIntro: Imilayezo evela kubantu abangaphandle koxhumana nabo ihlala lapha uze wamukela. Amagama nama-ID awaqinisekisiwe; Qhathanisa izigxivizo zeminwe ngaphambi kokuthembela kumuntu.
mrPolicy: Kugcinwe kule divayisi ngaphesheya kokulayisha kabusha kuze kufike ezinsukwini ezingu-7: abathumeli abangama-20, izimvilophu ezingama-20 ngamunye, ingqikithi eyi-100, ingqikithi ye-2 MiB (128 KiB imvilophu ngayinye). Imiyalezo eyeqile kanye nezingcingo ezingacelwanga ziyasuswa. Akukho lutho olususiwe noma oluhloliwe ngaphambi kokwamukela.
mrFull: Umkhawulo wesitoreji ufinyelelwe; Imilayezo emisha ilahliwe
mrFailed: Ayikwazanga ukubuyekeza izicelo zemiyalezo. Sicela uzame kabusha.
daLinked: Isisetshenziswa esixhunyiwe esingakaze sibonakale ngaphambilini (isignesha yezimpande iqinisekisiwe)
daSession: Okunye ukufakwa kusebenzise lesi sazisi (isignesha iqinisekisiwe)
daPush: Okunye ukufakwa kumemezele ukubhaliselwa kwe-push (isignesha iqinisekisiwe)
daRelayKeys: Relay ibika okhiye be-akhawunti abahlukile noma abalahlekile — ukungahambisani okungaqinisekisiwe
daUnavailable: Ukuhlolwa komsebenzi we-akhawunti akutholakali noma akuphelele. Mhlawumbe ukuphazamiseka kungase kuphazamise umsebenzi. Lokhu akulona ubufakazi bomshini omusha.
daLimit: Umsebenzi osayinwe kuphela ongaqinisekisiwa. I-relay ingagcina amarekhodi. Imibiko yeseshini nokucindezela idinga amaklayenti athuthukisiwe, asebenzisanayo.
daRecovery: Ukuxhuma kuhoxisa okhiye bedivayisi abaqinisekisiwe kontanga abanekhono ngemuva kokufika kwendawo yokuhlola esayiniwe; ontanga befa bayeka kuphela i-fan-out. Ubunikazi obukopishiwe noma okubhaliselwe kwe-push akukwazi ukuhoxiswa lapha: buyisela ubunikazi obusha, yazisa oxhumana nabo futhi uyeke ukusebenzisa ubunikazi obuthintekiwe.
cvReverify: Qhathanisa izinombolo zokuphepha bese uqinisekisa futhi
cvCompare: Qhathanisa le nombolo kuwo womabili amadivayisi. Kuhlanganisa kokubili ukubethela nokusayina okhiye:
cvMissingPin: Kuyadingeka ukhiye wokusayina ohlanganisiwe. Shintshanisa umyalezo oqinisekisiwe kuqala.
cvStrict: Vimbela ukuthumela ngemuva kokushintsha kokhiye kuze kuqinisekiswe kabusha
cvFailed: Ukuqinisekiswa kwehlulekile noma okhiye baguquliwe ngesikhathi sokuqhathanisa. Vula kabusha bese uqhathanisa futhi.
cvBlocked: Ukuthumela kuvinjiwe: okhiye bothintwa baguquliwe. Qhathanisa izinombolo zokuphepha bese uqinisekise kabusha, noma uvale imodi eqinile ku-/verify.
vaultNew: Isisho sokungena esisha se-vault (okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-12; hhayi igama lakho lokungena /lock)
vaultLegacy: Isisho sokungena esikhona /keywrap, noma shiya ingenanto uma ingekho
vaultScope: Vikela okhiye, imiyalezo / amafayela, oxhumana nabo, ama-drafts kanye nezilungiselelo zesiphequluli zangasese zawo wonke ama-akhawunti? Londoloza ibinzana lakho lokutakula kanye nokulondoloza ifayela le-vault kuqala. Isihloko, ulimi kanye nemvume kuhlala esidlangalaleni. /vault ukhiye wonke amathebhu; /vault ngegama lokungena lishintsha isisho sokungena.
vaultDisable: Khubaza i-vault ye-akhawunti ngayinye? Ukuqinisekiswa kuyadingeka. Umlando, amafayela, oxhumana nabo, okhiye, amadrafti kanye nezilungiselelo zesiphequluli sangasese zizobuyela esitorejini se-vault-off.
vaultFailed: Ukusebenza kwe-Vault kwehlulekile. Hlola isisho sokungena kanye nesitoreji; akukho ukubuyela emuva kombhalo ocacile ovunyelwe.
vaultRecovery: Lena akuyona iphasiwedi /lock. Uma ukhohliwe, thola ubunikazi bakho usebenzisa ibinzana lakho lokutakula ekufakweni okusha. Izinhlanganiso ezikhona ze-vault azikwazi ukutholwa ngaphandle kwalesi sisho sokungena.
vaultOldTabs: Vala amathebhu amadala e-Breeze ngaphambi kokushintsha i-vault.
vaultBackupOnly: Ngenkathi i-vault inikwe amandla, ukuthekelisa kuqukethe kuphela izithombe ze-vault ezifihliwe. Ukwelandwa okunamathiselwe, ifu, okuzenzakalelayo kanye nokuthekeliswa kwekhithi yokutakula kunqatshelwe.
opScope: Shintshanisa lezi zimo zimema ZOMBILI izindlela mathupha. Ziphelelwa yisikhathi ngemizuzu engama-30. Qhathanisa iminwe kuwo womabili amadivayisi bese uqinisekise kuphela uma iyahambisana. Gcina lolu hlelo lokusebenza luvulekile kuze /rendezvous luqede; Ukulayisha kabusha kukhansela kusalindwe ukubhangqa. Akukho ukubheka kwe-alias noma ukuqinisekiswa kwe-relay.
opCompare: Qhathanisa le minwe kuwo womabili amadivayisi. Ibopha zombili okhiye bokubethela, ukusayina okhiye nokumema ama-nonces.
opConfirmed: Othintana naye uqinisekisiwe. Vula ingxoxo yakho bese ushintshanisa amakhodi /rendezvous. Imiyalezo ivuleka ngemuva kokuqinisekiswa kokhiye ofihliwe.
opInvalid: Ukubhangqa okungaxhunyanisiwe kwehlulekile: akusebenzi, kuphelelwe yisikhathi, ikhodi/ukhiye osetshenzisiwe noma ongahambelani, noma i-cryptography engasekelwanga. Khansela ukubhangqa okulindile bese ushintshanisa izimemo ezintsha.
opPending: Qedela ukubhangqa okungaxhunyanisiwe ne-/rendezvous ngaphambi kokuthumela. Sebenzisa /offlinepair ukukhansela ukukhansela.
opCancelled: Kulindile ukubhangqa okungaxhunyanisiwe kukhanseliwe. Shintshanisa izimemo ezintsha kuwo womabili amadivayisi ukuze uzame kabusha.
rvScope: Kudinga isiwombe esikhona esifihliwe noma isimemo /offlinepair esiqinisekisiwe. Shintshanisa amakhodi wokuxhuma ngasese nge-QR noma ukukopisha / unamathisele; Ziphelelwa yisikhathi ngemizuzu eyi-10.
rvQRTooLarge: Le khodi inkulu kakhulu nge-QR eyodwa. Sebenzisa ukukopisha/unamathisele esikhundleni salokho.
rvScanUnavailable: Ukuskena kwekhamera ye-QR akutholakali kulesi siphequluli. Sebenzisa ukukopisha / unamathisele esikhundleni salokho.
rvReady: Ikhodi ilungele / isetshenzisiwe. Yikopishe kontanga yakho, noma unamathisele impendulo yabo.
rvCopyFallback: Ikhophi ayitholakali. Khetha bese ukopisha ikhodi ngesandla.
rvTrust: Xhuma kanye nge-relay bese uqinisekise lokhu oxhumana naye, noma uqede /offlinepair kuqala. Ukhiye wokusayina ohlanganisiwe kanye neseshini noma ukubhangqa okuqinisekisiwe okulindile kuyadingeka.
rvInvalid: Ikhodi yokuxhuma engaqinisekisiwe noma isinyathelo sokushintshana esingalungile.
rvExpired: Le khodi yokuxhumana iphelelwe yisikhathi. Yakha entsha.
rvTimeout: Ukuqoqwa kwe-ICE kuphelile. Sicela wenze kabusha ukushintshana.
rvCandidates: Awekho ama-ICE asebenzisekayo ngaphansi kwezilungiselelo zakho zobumfihlo. Hlola izimiso zakho zomphambo / TURN bese uphinda wenze ukushintshaniswa.
rvRedo: Ukuxhumeka ngesandla kudinga ukulungiswa. Phinda /rendezvous nontanga yakho.
heroDesc: Ayikho inombolo yocingo. Ayikho i-imeyili. Ayikho isitolo sohlelo lokusebenza. Vula isixhumanisi, qala ukuxoxa. Konke okubethelwe ekugcineni kuze kube sekupheleni.
inviteDesc: Faka igama lakho bese uqala - uzoxhunyaniswa nesimemo sakho ngokuzenzakalelayo. Akukho ukumiswa komnikezeli futhi akukho ukubhaliswa okudingekayo.

Engeza oxhumana nabo:

Namathisela isixhumanisi se-Breeze, @alias, ukhiye womphakathi, noma umyalezo wesimemo.

serverNotConfigured: Umnikezeli akamiswanga: ukubopha kwe-KV kuyadingeka. Landela ukusethwa kwe-README. I-P2P nokudluliselwa komyalezo akutholakali.
serverNoDefault: Akukho mnikezeli omisiwe. Engeza ukudluliselwa kwakho ku-Izilungiselelo →-Home relays, noma uzisingathe i-Breeze kuqala. Thepha leli bhanela ukuvula Izimiso.
gateServerDesc: I-Breeze ayinayo iseva esemthethweni. Engeza umnikezeli wakho ukuze uqalise. Isixhumanisi sesimemo sodwa akwanele — usadinga iseva yakho.
gateServerSteps: Cishe umzuzu owodwa, ngezinyathelo ezi-2: 1) Faka ikheli leseva yakho. 2) Hlola ifingerprint ebonisiwe bese uqinisekisa.
safetyDesc: Qhathanisa le nombolo nokuxhumana kwakho mathupha noma ngekholi yevidiyo. Uma zihambisana, uxhumano lwakho luphephile.

backupCreated: Isipele sesiphelile! Khumbula isisho lakho lokuphasiwela.

toastRecoveryNoneBackup: Lesi sazisi siyalahlwa (akukho ukutakula), ngakho-ke izipele azikwazi ukwakheka.
backupWrongPass: Isisho sokungena esingalungile noma ukusekela ngokulondoloza okonakele.

autoRestoreFoundDesc: Ukusekela ngokulondoloza kwale akhawunti kutholakale ekudluliseleni kwakho. Yibuyisele manje? Imininingwane yalesi sisetshenziswa izothathelwa indawo yi-backup.
migrateGuideDesc: 1. Kule divayisi, gcina isipele ku-relay yakho (isipele esizenzakalelayo ngenhla, noma Dala Isipele). 2. Kudivayisi entsha, khetha inketho yokubuyisela esikrinini sokuqala bese ufaka ibinzana lakho lokutakula - noma igama le-akhawunti yakho negama lokungena. 3. Lapho ubunikazi bakho bubuyile, isipele ku-relay yakho itholakala ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi inikezwa ukubuyiselwa. Azikho izintambo noma amafayela adingekayo.
backupNote: I-E2E ibhalwe ngokubethela. I-relay igcina kuphela i-ciphertext - futhi kuphela uma opharetha wayo enikwe amandla isitoreji sokulondoloza. Khumbula isisho lakho lokuphasiwela.

dropReadFailed: ❌ Yehlulekile ukukhipha ikhowudi. Isixhumanisi singase singavumelekile noma sonakele.
consentText: I-Breeze igcina imiyalezo nezimiso ezifihliwe endaweni yesisetshenziswa sakho. Ayikho idatha ethunyelwe kubantu besithathu.
noIDBDesc: I-IndexedDB ayitholakali. Lokhu kungenzeka kwimodi yokuphequlula yangasese / ye-incognito. I-Breeze idinga isitoreji ukulondoloza okhiye bakho nemilayezo ngokuphepha.
noCryptoDesc: I-WebCrypto API ayitholakali. I-Breeze idinga i-HTTPS nesiphequluli sanamuhla sokubethela kokuphela kokuphela.
noCryptoHint: Sicela ufinyelele ku-Breeze ngaphezulu kwe-HTTPS (hhayi i-HTTP).

relayAddTimeout: Leyo seva ithathe isikhathi eside ukuphendula — linda kancane bese uzama futhi. Uma kuqhubeka, hlola ukuthi iseva iyasebenza futhi ayithwali kakhulu.
relayAddNotBreeze: Lelo kheli liphendule, kodwa alifani neseva yeBreeze — qiniseka ukuthi i-URL ikhomba kwiserver yakho yeBreeze, hhayi kwebhusayithi noma kwenye i-app, bese uzama futhi.

recoveryPhraseDesc: Kukhonjiswe kanye. Ngale nkulumo kanye nesisho sakho sokungena sokutakula, le akhawunti ingabuyiselwa kudivayisi entsha - yinoma ngubani onakho kokubili, ngakho-ke zigcine endaweni ephephile. I-Breeze ayikwazi ukukukhombisa lokhu futhi noma ikubuyisele.
recoveryKitFileLabel: Ifayela lekhithi yokutakula (yama-akhawunti adalwe kuphela ngaphambi kwemishwana yokutakula)

toastRecoveryKitFailed: Ayikwazanga ukuvula ikhithi yokutakula — ibinzana noma isisho sokungena asihambisani naso.
toastRecoveryUnavailable: Imishwana yokutakula ayitholakali njengamanje — layisha kabusha bese uzama futhi.
toastRecoveryKitCreated: Ikhithi yokutakula ilandiwe. Ivula kuphela ngebinzana lakho lokutakula kanye ne-passphrase yakho - zigcine ndawonye.
toastRecoveryHasIdentity: Le divayisi isivele ine-identity — ukubuyiselwa kwegama kuyisiqalo esisha kuphela.
toastRecoveryMismatch: Leyo nkulumo negama lokudlula akuzona ezale ID ye-Breeze — akukho okubuyiselwe.
toastRecoveryNoneKit: Lesi sazisi siyalahlwa (akukho ukululama), ngakho-ke ikhithi yokutakula ayikwazi ukudalwa.
simpleDesc: Isipele sakho esibethelwe sizogcinwa ku-relay oyisebenzisayo noma inkontileka - lokhu akukaze kunikezwe ku-relay ezenzakalelayo. Kudivayisi entsha, igama le-akhawunti yakho + isisho sokungena sibuyisela yonke i-akhawunti, ngaphandle kwesisho sokubhala phansi. Ibuthakathaka kunebinzana lokutakula: noma ngubani osebenzisa leyo relay uphethe umbhalo we-ciphertext futhi angabona ukuthi le akhawunti ine-backup futhi uma ishintsha, futhi isisho sokungena esiqagelayo siyavula. I-relay ayikwazi ukuyifunda — kuphela isisho sokungena esingakwazi. Khetha eyodwa ende.
simpleNewDesc: Khetha igama le-akhawunti yokutakula - njengekheli le-imeyili, futhi kufanele ulikhumbule ngokuqondile - kanye negama lokungena lokubuyisela okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-8. Ngokubambisana balanda futhi bavule isipele sakho kudivayisi entsha. Akekho othunyelwa ku-relay; yilokho kuphela abakuvulayo.
simpleSaved: Ngiqaphele igama le-akhawunti kanye negama lokungena
simpleAccountMin: Igama le-akhawunti yokutakula kufanele okungenani libe nezinhlamvu ezi-3 (izinhlamvu, izinombolo, _ noma -).
simplePassMin: Isisho sokungena sokubuyiselwa esimeni kufanele okungenani sibe nezinhlamvu eziyi-8.
simpleEnrolled: Ukululama okulula kuyaqhubeka. Isilondolozo sakho esifihliwe sigcinwa ku-relay.
simpleEnrolledUntil: Ukululama okulula kuyaqhubeka. I-relay igcina isipele kuze kube yi-{0} — ibuyekeze kusuka /backup ngaphambi kwalokho.
simpleNotFound: Akukho ukusekela ngokulondoloza okutholakele kwalelo gama le-akhawunti kanye nenkulumo yokungena. Hlola kokubili ngokuqondile bese uzama futhi.
simpleRestoreDesc: Faka igama le-akhawunti yokutakula kanye nesisho sokungena osikhethile. Ukusekela ngokulondoloza kulandwa kulokhu kudluliselwa bese kuvulwa kulesi sisetshenziswa kuphela.
simplePassChangeDesc: Le nkulumo yokungena ibiza isikhala sokulondoloza esihlukile kunaleyo isilondolozo sakho samanje sihlala kuso. Isipele esidala sihlala ngaphansi kwegama elidala kuze kube yilapho liphelelwa yisikhathi (izinsuku ezingama-90); Ukubuyisela esimeni kuzodinga isisho sokungena esisha. Qhubeka kuphela uma lolu shintsho lwaluhlosiwe.

groupLegacyNoFs: ⚠️ Imfihlo yangaphambili ivaliwe kuleli qembu: ilungu likwinguqulo endala ngaphandle kweqembu le-v5. Bacele ukuthi babuyekeze ukuze bakwazi ukukusebenzisa.

migrateHtml:
Migrate from LINE / WhatsApp / Telegram
Step 1: Invite contacts (1-on-1)
Type /invite to copy an invite message → paste in LINE/WhatsApp
Type /qr to show a QR code → let them scan it
Step 1b: Move a whole group
Type /newgroup Your Group Name → generates an invite link
→ Paste the link in your LINE/WhatsApp group
→ Members just open the link to join automatically
Step 2: Import chat history
LINE: Chat → Settings → Send chat history → save .txt file
WhatsApp: Chat → More → Export chat → .txt
Telegram: Settings → Advanced → Export data → JSON
Type /import and select the file, or drag-drop onto the chat area
Step 3: Set up notifications
Allow browser notifications to get alerts for new messages
Add to Home Screen for an app-like experience

backupNudgeBody: Ukusekela ngokulondoloza ukuphela kwendlela yokubuyela kule akhawunti uma ulahlekelwe yilesi sisetshenziswa. Kuthatha isikhashana nje.
nicknameLocalNote: Izidlaliso zigcinwa kuphela kulesi sisetshenziswa. Azikaze zithunyelwe ku-contact noma i-relay.

helpSetSaveDisplayName: Ilondoloza igama lokubonisa ensimini bese yabelana ngephrofayili yakho ebuyekeziwe nabaxhumana nabo uhlelo lokusebenza olusekela amaphrofayli. Igama lisiza abantu ukuthi bakuqaphele; Akusona isihlonzi esiyingqayizivele.
helpSetKtBlock: Ivimba isiwombe esisha esifihliwe uma umlando wokusobala kokhiye ubukeka uguquliwe noma uchungechunge lwawo olulondoloziwe lungasahambelani. Lokhu kuphephile kunokuxwayisa kuphela, kepha kungakuvimba ekuthumeleni imiyalezo kuze kube yilapho ushintsho lokhiye luqinisekisiwe noma isilungiselelo sivaliwe.
helpSetBackup: Yakha ukusekela ngokulondoloza okufihliwe kokudluliselwa kwakho uma isilondolozo sokulondoloza sitholakala. I-relay igcina kuphela umbhalo ofihlakele, kodwa ukukhohlwa isisho sokungena kusho ukuthi isipele asikwazi ukubuyiselwa.
helpSetRestore: Ithola isilondolozo esifihlakeleyo sale akhawunti kuma-relays akho asekhaya bese uyibuyisela ngemuva kokufaka isisho sokungena esidingekayo. Ukubuyisela esimeni esikhundleni sedatha kulesi sisetshenziswa, ngakho-ke yisebenzise ngokucophelela.
helpSetAutoBackup: Ilondoloza ngokuzenzakalelayo isilondolozo esifihliwe ngemuva kokuthi imininingwane yakho iguquke. Isebenza kuphela ngemuva kokufaka isisho sokungena sokusekela ngokulondoloza kulesi sisetshenziswa, futhi kuphela uma ukudluliselwa kwakho kuhlinzeka ngesitoreji sokulondoloza.
helpSetAutobackupArm: Ikuvumela ukuthi ufake isisho sokungena sokusekela ngokulondoloza kanye ukuze ukusekela ngokulondoloza okuzenzakalelayo kusebenze phakathi nalesi siwombe. Isisho sokungena sigcinwa kuphela kwimemori, ngakho-ke kungadingeka ukuthi uyisebenzise futhi ngemuva kokulayisha kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza.
helpSetMigrateDevice: Ivula isiqondiso sesinyathelo ngesinyathelo sokuhambisa le akhawunti kwenye idivayisi usebenzisa ibinzana lakho lokutakula noma i-akhawunti yokutakula kanye nesisho sokungena. Isazisi sakho asikopishwa uze uqedele izinyathelo zokubuyisela esimeni kwisisetshenziswa esisha.
helpSetHideRr: Uyeka ukuthumela amarisidi afundwayo uma uvula ingxoxo yomuntu oyedwa. Abathumeli ngeke babone uma ufunda imiyalezo yabo; imilayezo ngokwayo isafika ngokujwayelekile.
helpSetHideTyping: Iyeka ukuthumela inkomba yokuthayipha ngenkathi ubhala. Oxhumana nabo ngeke babone lapho ubhala impendulo, kepha usengabona eyabo uma babelana ngayo.
helpSetRelayOnly: Ihambisa ithrafikhi yontanga ngokusebenzisa amaseva wokudlulisela esikhundleni sokuxhumana okuqondile, ukufihla ikheli lakho le-IP koxhumana nabo. Ingenza izingcingo nokudluliswa kwefayela kancane kancane noma kwehluleke lapho kungekho ukudluliselwa okusebenzisekayo okutholakalayo, futhi opharetha we-relay usengabona imethadatha yokuxhumana.
helpSetNotifSound: Idlala umsindo omfushane lapho umlayezo noma ucingo oluvunyelwe ukukuxwayisa lufika. Izaziso ezibonakalayo zihlukile, futhi imodi yokugxila noma izingxoxo ezithulile zisakwazi ukuthulisa izixwayiso.
helpSetSendSound: Idlala umsindo omfushane uma uthumela umyalezo. Kuyisiqinisekiso sendawo kuphela futhi akusho ukuthi omunye umuntu uyitholile noma uyifundile.
helpSetTabVisCalls: Ibonisa noma ifihla ithebhu Yezingcingo kubha yethebhu engezansi. Ukuyifihla akususi umlando wekholi noma ukukhubaza ukushaya ucingo.
helpSetTabVisContacts: Ibonisa noma ifihla ithebhu Yabathintwayo kubha yethebhu engezansi. Ukuyifihla akususi oxhumana nabo noma izingxoxo zakho.
helpSetTabVisSelf: Ibonisa noma ifihla ithebhu Yeprofayili kubha yethebhu engezansi. Iphrofayili yakho ihlala ikhona, futhi lokhu akushintshi ukuthi kwabelwana ngakho yini.
helpSetTabVisSettings: Ibonisa noma ifihla ithebhu Yezimiso kubha yethebhu engezansi. Uma uyifihla ngenkathi usebenzisa Izilungiselelo, i-Breeze ibuyela ku-Chats; Izimiso zihlala zitholakala kwinkinobho yezimiso noma imiyalo.
helpSetCallHistoryLog: Igcina uhlu lwasendaweni lwezingcingo eziphumayo, ezingenayo, nezilahlekile kulesi sisetshenziswa. Yivale ukuze umise amarekhodi amasha wekholi lapha; Ayisusi umlando osevele ulondoloziwe.
helpSetAutoLock: Uma iphasiwedi yokukhiya uhlelo lokusebenza isethiwe, ikhiya i-Breeze uma ushintsha kuthebhu yayo. Uzodinga lelo phasiwedi uma ubuya; Lokhu akuthathi isikhundla sokukhiya umshini uqobo.
helpSetNotifPerm: Cela isiphequluli noma isistimu yokusebenza imvume yokubonisa izaziso. I-Breeze ayikwazi ukunikeza lokhu ngokwayo; Uma imvume inqatshelwe ngaphambilini, kungadingeka ukuthi uyishintshe kusiphequluli noma kuzilungiselelo zesistimu.
helpSetShowPeerName: Ibonisa igama oxhumana naye azikhethele lona eceleni kwesidlaliso osinikeze sona. Lokhu kushintsha kuphela lokho okubonayo endaweni; Akukho okwengeziwe okuthunyelwe ku-contact noma i-relay.
helpSetAddRelay: Engeza enye i-relay yasekhaya ngemuva kokubonisa iminwe yayo yokuqinisekisa. Ukudluliselwa kwasekhaya okungeziwe kungathuthukisa ukutholakala, kepha ngamunye angabona imethadatha efana nokuthi ingakanani ithrafikhi ebethelwe edlula kuyo.
helpSetRemoveRelay: Isusa ukudluliselwa kwasekhaya okungeziwe ohlwini lwalesi sisetshenziswa. I-relay igcina i-ciphertext eseyitholile kuze kuphelelwe yisikhathi okujwayelekile; Ukususwa kuvimbela kuphela amakhophi esikhathi esizayo ekusebenziseni leyo relay.
helpSetFanout: Kwabathintwa abasebenzisa ama-relays asekhaya amaningi, ithumela ikhophi yomlayezo ngamunye kulokhu okuningi kwalezo zidluliselo. Amakhophi amaningi angathuthukisa ukulethwa uma ukudluliselwa okukodwa kuphansi, kepha basebenzisa ithrafikhi yenethiwekhi futhi bagcine i-ciphertext ezindaweni eziningi.
helpSetPowerMode: Ilawula ukuthi i-Breeze inciphisa kangakanani ukuhlola isizinda ukonga ibhethri. Ukuthumela akubambezelekile, kepha i-Saver ne-Emergency ingenza imilayezo engenayo nezibuyekezo zobukhona zifike kamuva; Ilandela ngokuzenzakalelayo ibhethri lakho lapho isiphequluli sibika.
helpSetRrDelay: Linda cishe imizuzu emibili, ngokuhlukahluka okuncane okungahleliwe, ngaphambi kokuthumela irisidi efundwayo. Lokhu kwenza isikhathi sakho sokufunda esiqondile singaqondile, kepha abathumeli ekugcineni bafunda ukuthi umyalezo ufundwe.
helpSetFocus: Ivula imodi yokugxila ihora elilodwa. Izaziso eziningi zemiyalezo zithuliswa ngenkathi zivuliwe; Oxhumana nabo be-VIP nokukhulunywa kungakuxwayisa ngaphandle kokuthi imodi eqinile ivuliwe.
helpSetFocusStrict: Isusa i-VIP bese ukhuluma ngokuhlukile kwimodi yokugxila, ngakho-ke izaziso zomlayezo zithule kuwo wonke umuntu. Imisindo yendandatho yekholi engenayo nayo icindezelwe, yize uhlelo lwakho lungase lubonise isaziso esibonakalayo.
helpSetRestoreFile: Ibuyisela ngokulondoloza ngokufihlakeleyo ngokufihlakeleyo kwifayela olilondolozile phambilini. Udinga isisho sokungena sokusekela ngokulondoloza, futhi imininingwane ebuyiselwe esimeni ithatha indawo yalokho okukulesi sisetshenziswa.
helpSetInviteFriend: Yakha isixhumanisi noma umyalezo othile angawusebenzisa ukukwengeza ku-Breeze. Noma ngubani onesixhumanisi angakwazi ukusisebenzisa, ngakho-ke wabelane nomuntu ofuna ukummema kuphela.
helpSetMigrateApps: Ivula umhlahlandlela wokuhambisa oxhumana nabo noma amaqembu kusuka ku-LINE, WhatsApp, noma Telegram kuya ku-Breeze, kufaka phakathi ukungenisa umlando wengxoxo ozikhethela. Umlando ongenisiwe uqukethe kuphela lokho okuthunyelwe ngolunye uhlelo lokusebenza.
cfStatusSaved: Ithokheni ilondoloziwe kulesi sisetshenziswa, kodwa ayikaqinisekiswa okwamanje.
cfStatusConnectedNoAccounts: Ithokheni iqinisekisiwe. Isimo sethokheni: {0}; Awekho ama-akhawunti abonakalayo kulesi sithombe.
cfErrNoProxy: Ukusethwa kwe-Cloudflare kudinga ukudluliselwa kwe-Breeze okulungiselelwe kwe-proxy ye-API. Engeza i-relay yasekhaya kuqala, noma uzisingathe i-Breeze bese ugijima ukusetha lapho.
cfNote: Ithokheni igcinwa kuphela kulo mshini. Izicelo zesiphequluli zidlula ngokungajwayelekile nge-/api / cf-proxy yale mvelaphi ku-API ye-Cloudflare ngaphandle kokungena ngemvume noma ukugcinwa. Ama-relays aqinisekisiwe ngokhiye wokudlulisela afakwa kuma-Relays asekhaya ngokuzenzakalelayo.
helpSetCloudflareSave: Igcina ithokheni ye-Cloudflare API kuphela esitolo sezimiso ze-IndexedDB salesi sisetshenziswa. Ithunyelwa kuphela ku-API ye-Cloudflare njengethokheni ye-Bearer, hhayi ku-Breeze relays. Ukusethwa kweseva kudinga ithokheni eline-akhawunti efundwayo (uhlu lwama-akhawunti), ukuhlela kwe-Workers Scripts, kanye nezimvume zokuhlela ze-Workers KV Storage.
helpSetCloudflareVerify: Ibiza ukuqinisekiswa kwethokheni ye-Cloudflare kanye nama-API ohlwini lwe-akhawunti ngethokheni elondolozwe kule divayisi, bese ikhombisa isimo sangempela sethokheni namagama e-akhawunti noma iphutha langempela. Ithokheni ithunyelwa kuphela ku-API ye-Cloudflare. Ukumiswa kweseva kudinga ukufundwa kwe-akhawunti (uhlu lwama-akhawunti), ukuhlela kwemibhalo yabasebenzi, kanye nezimvume zokuhlela ze-Workers KV Storage.
helpSetCloudflareDisconnect: Isusa ithokheni ye-Cloudflare API elondoloziwe esitolo sezimiso ze-IndexedDB yalesi sisetshenziswa bese isula isimo sokuxhuma esikhonjisiwe. Ayihoxisi ithokheni, futhi ayisusi i-Worker, isikhala segama le-KV, noma yimuphi omunye umthombo ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Cloudflare.
cfSetupDone: Iseva ilungele futhi ihlolwe impilo: {0}. Yifake njenge-relays yasekhaya kusuka esigabeni se-Relays.
cfSetupUnverified: Isisebenzi sithunyelwe ku-{0}, kodwa ukuhlolwa kwezempilo akuzange kuphendule ({1}). Engeza njenge-relay yasekhaya kuphela ngemuva kokuyihlola.
cfErrNoAccount: ayikho i-akhawunti ye-Cloudflare ebonakalayo kulesi sithokheni
helpSetCloudflareSetup: Yakha noma isebenzise kabusha isikhala segama le-KV ekhona i-breeze, ilayisha i-Breeze Worker ehlanganisiwe njenge-breeze script ngokubopha kwe-KV okudingekayo, inika amandla ikheli layo le-workers.dev, futhi ihlola i-/api / impilo. Ithokheni idinga ukufundwa kwe-akhawunti (uhlu lwama-akhawunti), i-Workers Scripts edit, kanye ne-Workers KV Storage edit. I-URL yomnikezeli igcinwa kulesi sisetshenziswa kuphela; Faka i-backlink yasekhaya uma ufuna ukuyisebenzisa. Ukusetha akulungiseleli izimfihlo zokuzikhethela zezaziso zokucindezela, i-TURN, noma ukhiye wobunikazi be-relay, ngakho-ke lezo zici zihlala zivaliwe noma zisemuva ngokuzenzakalelayo kuze kube yilapho zilungiselelwe kudeshibodi ye-Cloudflare.
lnSimilar: "{0}" ifana nokuxhumana okukhona "{1}" ({2}). Qhathanisa izigxivizo zeminwe ngaphambi kokuthembela kuleli gama.
lnUnsafe: "{0}" iqukethe izinhlamvu ezifihliwe / zokulawula noma inhlanganisela eyingozi yemibhalo. Qhathanisa izigxivizo zeminwe ngaphambi kokuthembela kuleli gama.
cfGuideText: Yakha ithokheni ye-API ngezilungiselelo ze-akhawunti: Funda, Imibhalo Yabasebenzi: Hlela, kanye Nezisebenzi KV Isitoreji: Hlela, bese uyinamathisela ngezansi.
helpSetCloudflareQuick: Ilondoloza ithokheni ye-Cloudflare API enamathiselwe kule divayisi, iqinisekise i-akhawunti, idala i-KV namespace kanye ne-subdomain workers.dev uma kunesidingo, isebenzisa i-Breeze Worker, futhi ihlola i-/api / impilo ngesinyathelo esisodwa.

helpSetTabOrder: Ishintsha ukulandelana kwamathebhu aphansi. Hudula umugqa, noma usebenzise izinkinobho zomcibisholo; Ibha yethebhu ibuyekezwa ngokushesha. Izingxoxo zingahlelwa kabusha, kepha zihlala ziboniswa ngaso sonke isikhathi.
helpSetInstallApp: Ivula ukufakwa kohlelo lokusebenza ngokuchofoza okukodwa lapho isiphequluli sinikeza. Uma lokho okusheshayo kungatholakali, kubonisa imiyalelo yokufaka noma ibhanela lokulanda ideskithophu esikhundleni salokho.
